purpose: Counterexamples and representative flight probes for the #709 review; not authored difficulty thresholds or a hit-rate cohort.
limitations: Still air, fixed launch and exit speed, no launch noise, no contact distribution or player input.
The three ground probes are illustrative trajectories, not classifications of a fielding opportunity. Awkward-hop difficulty requires actual arrival relative to the fielder and bounce.
Air probes use explicit unrounded mean contact inputs, neutral chemistry/pitch factors and the named star exit multiplier; they do not run AtBatResolver or implement special effects.
Near-pole probes use 44.9 degrees to stay inside fair territory; fence distance and height use the actual C80 boundary at that spray.
Production BallFlight and FieldBounds run with in-memory C80 fences and drag overrides; there is no pursuit, acquisition, throwing, baserunning or full compact-game simulation.
Ground station velocities are sampled segment velocities on the actual play clock, not unscaled internal integration velocities.

probes.basis: Authored routine-ground trajectory probe; opportunity reliability is not evaluated.
